title: Find Subsequence of Length K With the Largest Sum
goal: Keep a length-k subsequence with maximum sum while preserving original order.
strategy: Choose the indices of the k largest values, breaking ties consistently by earlier index. Sorting those chosen indices restores the required subsequence order without changing the sum.
